gen.title: Water continuously circulates in the hydrologic cycle
gen.orderNote: Steps follow the order presented in the source.

steps.label: Water evaporates from surface
steps.quote: Evaporation is the change of state in a substance from a liquid to a gas.
steps.orderHint: Remember that liquid water needs energy to become vapor.

steps.label: Plants release water to air
steps.quote: Transpiration is the evaporation of water from plants through stomata.
steps.orderHint: Think about water leaving leaves through tiny openings.

steps.label: Vapor condenses into liquid
steps.quote: Condensation is the process whereby water vapor is changed into a liquid state.
steps.orderHint: Recall how cooling vapor forms liquid.

steps.label: Runoff flows to rivers and oceans
steps.quote: Runoff occurs when there is excessive precipitation and the ground is saturated (cannot absorb any more water).
steps.orderHint: Notice what happens when the ground cannot absorb more water.
